description: Rough acceptance chance: a selectivity tier base rate (92, 80, 50, 20, or 5 percent) adjusted by GPA and test score bands, clamped to 1 to 99 percent and labeled Safety, Target, Reach, or High reach. SAT is used when provided, otherwise ACT. Use when the user wants a rough admission chance for a college selectivity tier. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive College Acceptance calculator.

act.description: ACT composite score, used only when no SAT is given, or 0 to leave out; default 0.

sat.description: SAT total score, or 0 to leave out; default 0.

tier_base_pct.description: Selectivity tier base rate percent from the page: 92 open admission, 80 less selective, 50 selective, 20 highly selective, 5 most selective; default 20.

name: calculate_college_acceptance

calculator_url.description: Deep link to the matching interactive calculator on everycalc.xyz.

inputs.description: The normalized inputs the calculation used.

results.description: The computed figures for this calculator.

tool.description: Name of the tool that ran.
